name: linalg_ldl_solve
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::linalg_ldl_solve(Tensor LD, Tensor pivots, Tensor B, *, bool hermitian=False) -> Tensor. Solves systems from compact LDL factors without mutating or aliasing the inputs. Tests preserve real/complex, batched, and rectangular right-hand-side coverage and additionally cover Hermitian complex systems, noncontiguous and empty right-hand sides, return independence, and invalid rank, shape, batch, and dtype contracts.
